request: Complete redesign of Vidra Fresh / Media picker (929:87910) with Mobbin references, via /design:design-critique.
critique: A centred 704 x 468 modal with a backdrop detached the picker from the composer slot or editor control that opened it, unlike every other Vidra picker (Model picker, settings, Use menu), which anchors 6px from its trigger.

Select-then-confirm took two or three steps: a tile click only selected, a disabled 'Use as input' / 'Add to video' button waited in the footer, and C44 added a second Version picker popover with its own 'Use version 2' and Cancel.
The footer jumped between states: Cancel and the primary button sat left under the grid in Browse and moved right beside a 'Desk · v2 selected' label in Selected.
Only three media items fit in 704 x 468, with about 120px of empty space under them; the search field and the 'Images' / 'Images and clips' button stopped about 200px short of the right edge.
'Images' and 'Images and clips' looked like buttons but did nothing; they were labels.
Every tile repeated a meta line ('v1 · Image', 'v2 · Image · adds 3 seconds', 'v1 · 4-second clip'), and the copy said image where the vocabulary is picture or clip.
The selected tile used a gold outline and a lighter card, which is louder than the quiet selected treatment used elsewhere.
The empty state said 'No media matches your search.' while the search field showed only its placeholder.
Unavailable replaced the whole grid with 'This media is no longer available.' and a 'Choose another' button inside the chooser itself.
In the editor, the modal repeated the left Media panel, and clicking a Media panel tile opened the modal with that same item preselected.

direction: Anchored popover on the Menu surface (surface/raised, border/default, radius/menu, space/8 padding, Vidra Fresh / Floating), Interface=Raised mode, one fixed size of 336 x 336 for every state because it is bottom-anchored.
Inputs open 6px above the composer with left edges aligned; the editor opens 6px from Choose media (below) or Add media (above), left edges aligned.
No backdrop, title, close button, Cancel or footer. Escape or an outside click closes it without changing anything.
Top row is a Field bar: search (Search pictures / Search media) and Upload; Use=Video edit adds an All / Pictures / Clips filter segment.
Two-column grid of Vidra Fresh / Media option tiles, 156 x 88, radius/control. Tiles show only the picture; clips add a duration chip on surface/overlay.
Choosing a tile applies that exact version and closes the picker. Each tile is one exact version, so no version picker or confirm step is needed.
Selected marks the media already in the slot with the 2px text/primary ring used by Media tile.

Loading shows six skeleton tiles. Empty shows the typed query, 'No matching pictures' or 'No matching media' and Clear search. Unavailable shows a one-line Danger Notice ('Desk · v2 is no longer available') above the remaining tiles.
